brief: Opportunity is heavily concentrated in Brooklyn market-tier parcels where combining 485-x tax exemptions with Section 8 VPS rents produces high returns and substantial land headroom. Across the 1,271 scanned lots, top-performing Brooklyn options yield 12.0% to 31.8% cash-on-cash returns, while Bronx sites offer program-driven development fee opportunities via ELLA/4% LIHTC stacks. Notably, all top candidates are city-owned lots, meaning acquisition requires public disposition rather than private seller negotiation.
